consequence.statement: log output format has changed; environments that parse or filter cert-manager logs using text-based tools may need to update their log filtering logic.

original.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds more structured logging information to certain log lines, changing their format; text-based log filtering tools may be affected.

decision.reason: [ev-95c9a508db46] says some log lines changed format because more structured logging information was added, and warns anyone filtering logs with grep or similar tools to be aware of it. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. cert-manager still works; only the log output looks different. That makes this a behavior-change needing review, and low severity fits.
